name: Stoat
description: Stoat is a self-hosted chat server, formerly Revolt. This stack runs the API, web app, file server, proxy, and voice ingress behind Caddy.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Revolt api livekit nodes worldwide key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Revolt api livekit nodes worldwide secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Rabbitmq default pass
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Minio root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Revolt files encryption key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Revolt pushd vapid public key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  database:
    image: mongo:9.0.2@sha256:bac22ea7710d774103dcad3ec8ac13cba1eb378f488e3ce8a6b3a1adf2ba9dcc
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/db:/data/db
    healthcheck:
      test: echo 'db.runCommand("ping").ok' | mongosh localhost:27017/test --quiet
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
  redis:
    image: valkey/valkey:9.1.2-alpine@sha256:48332870af354a799964c0012ae1194a0bf2bf894eb508f945810596dc2d8d11
    restart: unless-stopped
  rabbit:
    image: rabbitmq:4.4.0@sha256:485319d42170eab53d8a030e1cc49d95e41f5d325479fa504736db8091981eb7
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: rabbituser
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${SECRET_RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/rabbit:/var/lib/rabbitmq
    healthcheck:
      test: rabbitmq-diagnostics -q ping
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
  minio:
    image: pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z@sha256:635197cb9f36d01bee221d34d1c7d7960f6a95c48b0b6c01d99cd13bdae51a46
    command: server /data
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/minio:/data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: stoatfiles
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      MINIO_DOMAIN: minio
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - revolt-uploads.minio
          - attachments.minio
          - avatars.minio
          - backgrounds.minio
          - icons.minio
          - banners.minio
          - emojis.minio
  caddy:
    image: caddy:2.11.7@sha256:5e5286cb37d44086d651a5363f05f43a692ce4d649d88fb1bd844579f45fa9e8
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      HOSTNAME: "https://stoat.localhost"
    ports:
      - "20001:80"
      - "${APP_PORT}:443"
    configs:
      - source: caddyfile
        target: /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/caddy-data:/data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/caddy-config:/config
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - stoat.localhost
          - stoat
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/for-web:4017c18@sha256:07d87ec847b11adf39f37352af736b51c0b7ad3e21724f069e341d45d5ae755e
    container_name: stoat-web
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      HOSTNAME: "https://stoat.localhost"
      VITE_HOST: "stoat.localhost"
      VITE_API_URL: "https://stoat.localhost/api"
      VITE_DEV_GIFBOX_URL: "https://stoat.localhost/gifbox"
  api:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/api:v0.15.5@sha256:35d3c03f0fc4aad4a7b23eb73af88b38fd134a274f991435fb23b32724619b52
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: &stoat_env
      REVOLT__DATABASE__MONGODB: mongodb://database
      REVOLT__DATABASE__REDIS: redis://redis/
      REVOLT__RABBIT__HOST: rabbit
      REVOLT__RABBIT__PORT: "5672"
      REVOLT__RABBIT__USERNAME: rabbituser
      REVOLT__RABBIT__PASSWORD: ${SECRET_RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS}
      REVOLT__FILES__ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${SECRET_REVOLT_FILES_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
      REVOLT__FILES__S3__ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      REVOLT__FILES__S3__REGION: minio
      REVOLT__FILES__S3__ACCESS_KEY_ID: stoatfiles
      REVOLT__FILES__S3__SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${SECRET_MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      REVOLT__FILES__S3__DEFAULT_BUCKET: revolt-uploads
      REVOLT__PUSHD__VAPID__PRIVATE_KEY: 
      REVOLT__PUSHD__VAPID__PUBLIC_KEY: ${SECRET_REVOLT_PUSHD_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY}
      REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY: ${SECRET_REVOLT_API_LIVEKIT_NODES_WORLDWIDE_KEY}
      REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__SECRET: ${SECRET_REVOLT_API_LIVEKIT_NODES_WORLDWIDE_SECRET}
      REVOLT__HOSTS__APP: "https://stoat.localhost"
      REVOLT__HOSTS__API: "https://stoat.localhost/api"
      REVOLT__HOSTS__EVENTS: "wss://stoat.localhost/ws"
      REVOLT__HOSTS__AUTUMN: "https://stoat.localhost/autumn"
      REVOLT__HOSTS__JANUARY: "https://stoat.localhost/january"
      REVOLT__HOSTS__GIFBOX: "https://stoat.localhost/gifbox"
      REVOLT__HOSTS__LIVEKIT__WORLDWIDE: "wss://stoat.localhost/livekit"
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
      rabbit:
        condition: service_healthy
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  events:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/events:v0.15.5@sha256:e80d621d13560233b26d55cdc2a6ac2eb953ef54335912a23e27ce5e2b238990
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  autumn:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/file-server:v0.15.5@sha256:5fd3354f5e0adf866a9875dd1cb7d15d45adbd5c49ba0ba96c65dbead1e175b3
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
      createbuckets:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  january:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/proxy:v0.15.5@sha256:338a01081d89a519c2588836e70abf43449306ab169ab746fd141abb25c4d302
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  gifbox:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/gifbox:v0.15.5@sha256:de0e531e1412ee60941c1f3efcae099007e2eac2a2ad7359e8b5af98c8e56dee
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  crond:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/crond:v0.15.5@sha256:9a07f9414fbcea7f0161e140e12969aac41fd6655b61869cfa8916dce319c81a
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_started
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  pushd:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/pushd:v0.15.5@sha256:c2661c5cea6bb679dfc085cb3d2902ab1b3b34e14c89915630144342bdd1c7f3
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_started
      rabbit:
        condition: service_healthy
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  voice-ingress:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/voice-ingress:v0.15.5@sha256:b7bade2d212e1d52a0a66a52c7584b6de34fc20f9692d5146e20e748a835009e
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *stoat_env
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbit:
        condition: service_healthy
    configs:
      - source: revolt_toml
        target: /Revolt.toml
  livekit-config:
    image: pgsty/mc:RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z@sha256:cfc83108c3abb371f8fb84d99c1fdc88f8c237e022409b0081fb7c0a3be634dd
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY: ${SECRET_REVOLT_API_LIVEKIT_NODES_WORLDWIDE_KEY}
      REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__SECRET: ${SECRET_REVOLT_API_LIVEKIT_NODES_WORLDWIDE_SECRET}
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        cat > /out/livekit.yml << EOF
        rtc:
          use_external_ip: true
          port_range_start: 21028
          port_range_end: 21128
          tcp_port: 7881
        redis:
          address: redis:6379
        turn:
          enabled: false
        keys:
          "$$REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY": "$$REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__SECRET"
        webhook:
          api_key: "$$REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY"
          urls:
            - "http://voice-ingress:8500/worldwide"
        EOF
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/livekit:/out
  livekit:
    image: ghcr.io/stoatchat/livekit-server:v1.9.14@sha256:4de8cdeabcb87a049b93f396c9616cd968bcad013de78e16881bec069e10b710
    command: --config /etc/livekit/livekit.yml
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_started
      livekit-config:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    ports:
      - "7881:7881"
      - "21028-21128:21028-21128/udp"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/livekit:/etc/livekit
  createbuckets:
    image: pgsty/mc:RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z@sha256:cfc83108c3abb371f8fb84d99c1fdc88f8c237e022409b0081fb7c0a3be634dd
    restart: "no"
    depends_on:
      - minio
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: stoatfiles
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        until /usr/bin/mc alias set minio http://minio:9000 "$$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD" && /usr/bin/mc ready minio; do
          echo 'Waiting minio...'
          sleep 1
        done
        /usr/bin/mc mb minio/revolt-uploads || /usr/bin/mc stat minio/revolt-uploads
configs:
  caddyfile:
    content: |
      {$$HOSTNAME} {
      route /.well-known/stoat {
      header Access-Control-Allow-Origin *
      respond "{\"api\":\"{$$HOSTNAME}/api\"}"
      }

      route /api* {
      uri strip_prefix /api
      reverse_proxy http://api:14702 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/api/"
      }
      }

      route /ws {
      uri strip_prefix /ws
      reverse_proxy http://events:14703 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/ws/"
      }
      }

      route /autumn* {
      uri strip_prefix /autumn
      reverse_proxy http://autumn:14704 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/autumn/"
      }
      }

      route /january* {
      uri strip_prefix /january
      reverse_proxy http://january:14705 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/january/"
      }
      }

      route /gifbox* {
      uri strip_prefix /gifbox
      reverse_proxy http://gifbox:14706 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/gifbox/"
      }
      }

      route /livekit* {
      uri strip_prefix /livekit
      reverse_proxy http://livekit:7880 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/livekit/"
      }
      }

      route /ingress* {
      uri strip_prefix /ingress
      reverse_proxy http://voice-ingress:8500 {
      header_down Location "^/" "/ingress/"
      }
      }

      reverse_proxy http://web:5000
      }
  revolt_toml:
    content: |
      [api.livekit.nodes.worldwide]
      url = "http://livekit:7880"
      lat = 0.0
      lon = 0.0

      [features.limits.new_user]
      video_resolution = [1920, 1080]
      video_aspect_ratio = [0.3, 10]

      [features.limits.default]
      video_resolution = [1920, 1080]
      video_aspect_ratio = [0.3, 10]

      [files.s3]
      path_style_buckets = false
notes: The hostname is the literal stoat.localhost. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit environment literals; they do not substitute Compose variables. Before the first start, replace stoat.localhost in HOSTNAME, the VITE variables, and every REVOLT__HOSTS__* value. Caddy reads HOSTNAME. Stoat reads those REVOLT__HOSTS__* values over Revolt.toml. Point DNS at this machine. Forward external port 80 to host 20001 and external port 443 to host 20002. The shipped RabbitMQ password, Silo password, file encryption key, VAPID key, and LiveKit key pair are public. Replace them before storing data or exposing voice, then keep the file encryption key stable. Set the same Silo user and password on minio and createbuckets. Set the same LiveKit key and secret on the API services and on livekit-config, which writes livekit.yml on start. Forward UDP 21028-21128 and TCP 7881 for voice. The web image publishes amd64 only.
